execute.description: Replaces the old device with the new one. Mapped entities keep their entity ID, history, statistics and settings and move to the new device.

auto_match.name: Match automatically

force.name: Force

keep_units.description: Keep showing sensors in the old unit when the new one reports a convertible unit.
keep_units.name: Keep units

auto_match.name: Match automatically

mapping.description: Old entity ID to new entity ID; null leaves an old entity unmapped.
mapping.name: Mapping

plan.name: Plan replacement

undo.name: Undo replacement
undo.description: Moves the entities back to the old device, restores the new device's settings and device references, and removes the Repairs issues of the replacement.

record_id.name: Replacement
record_id.description: ID of the journal record; the latest replacement that can be undone if empty.

confirm.title: {entity_id} was not carried over to {new_device}
confirm.description:
When {old_device} was replaced with {new_device}, {entity_id} had no counterpart on the new device, but it is still used in: {used_in}.

Change or remove those references, then confirm.

device_automation_unsupported.title: {automation} uses a device {section} {new_device} does not offer

confirm.title: {automation} uses a device {section} {new_device} does not offer
confirm.description:
{automation} uses the device {section} "{type}" of {old_device}. Its device ID now points at {new_device}, which does not offer it, so it will not work.

Edit the automation to use something {new_device} offers, then confirm.

confirm.title: {kind} {name} still refers to {old_device}
confirm.description: The {kind} {name} refers to the replaced device {old_device} in configuration that Home Assistant does not manage (YAML), so it was not updated. Replace the old device ID with the one of {new_device}, then confirm.

replace.title: Replace a device
replace.description: Pick the device that broke and the device taking its place. The old device should be offline.

mapping.title: Map entities
mapping.description: For every entity of {old_device}, choose the entity of {new_device} that takes over. A mapped entity keeps its entity ID, history, statistics and settings; the new entity's own ID disappears.

data_description.keep_units: Keep showing sensors in the old unit when the new device reports another unit that converts (kW instead of W).
data_description.adjust_energy: Shift the statistics sum of meters so the swap does not count as consumption.
data_description.remove_old_device: Removing the old device makes the replacement impossible to undo.
data_description.force: For example when the integration never marks a dead device unavailable.

undo.title: Undo a replacement
undo.description: The entities go back to the old device, which is enabled again. Statistics are not changed.

progress.replacing: Replacing the device. The integration of the new device reloads, which can take up to a minute.
progress.undoing: Undoing the replacement. The integrations reload, which can take up to a minute.

abort.nothing_to_undo:
There is no replacement that can be undone. Recent replacements:

{recent}

error.duplicate_new: A new entity can take over only one old entity.
